title: Shenandoah Harmony - Lover's Lamentation (arrangement)
description:
A tense and solemn song to be used in temple or castle levels. What I get from the lyrics is the character grieves a relative or a lover. So it may also work in a cutscene.

If you click on the below link, you'll see I adapted the song in order to have all the channels playing no matter what. So it would not feel too empty. I think I've done that at best of my capacity.
